root_cause: The navigation controller adds a new keydown event listener each time the suggestion list is regenerated, without removing the previous listener. This causes multiple listeners to fire on key presses, leading to the wrong item being selected (the old listener's focus index) when Enter is pressed.
repair_strategy: Modify the navigate function in navigationController.js to store the current keydown listener on the config object and remove any existing listener before adding a new one. This ensures only one listener is active at a time.
expected_accessibility_effect: Ensures that keyboard navigation (arrow keys and Enter) correctly selects the highlighted suggestion, maintaining consistent ARIA attribute updates (aria-selected, aria-activedescendant) and preventing duplicate event handlers that could cause focus mismatches.
functional_risks: Minimal risk; the change only affects the keydown listener management. Existing functionality for ESC, arrow keys, and Tab should remain unchanged. The self-removal mechanism when the list is closed is preserved.
verification_requirements: Run the provided journey test to confirm that typing 'b', two ArrowDown, 'l', ArrowDown, Enter results in form-data fruit = ['Blackberry'].
Verify that no duplicate keydown listeners are added by checking event listener count on the input field after multiple input events.
